info.description: A brief-to-streaming-TV-ad-package API, reverse engineered from the prompt-to-TV workflow (Claude or ChatGPT writes the script, Higgsfield renders the clips, a platform like Vibe places the spot). Submit a brief (brand, product, audience, offer, call to action, tone, 15 or 30 seconds) and get the complete production package: a timed script with word budgets enforced in code (72 words max at 30 s, 36 at 15 s, the end-card read included), a shot-by-shot list with a ready-to-paste Higgsfield generation prompt per shot, the voiceover text with a ready payload for the SwiftRead text-to-speech API, end-card copy, the CTV delivery spec (Vibe's published upload requirements plus the industry standard: 1920x1080, mp4, -24 LKFS plus or minus 2, true peak at or below -2 dBTP) and a compliance checklist. POST /check-spec scores a finished file's measured specs against that delivery spec before anyone pays for placement. SpotBase does not render video, synthesize audio, or place ads on TV; placement requires the advertiser's own funded platform account. Built-in template engine live with no key; an optional Gemini drafting engine activates with the operator's own key and every response names the engine that produced it.
